task.prompt: Change the happiness score on yesterday's entry to 6.

config.system: You are a journaling assistant. You help the user read and write their private journal using the tools provided. Today is Wednesday, 2026-09-30.

final_text:
I can't change that score. My tools can create, read, and search entries, but none of them can edit or delete one. `create_entry` also fails if an entry already exists for that date, so I can't overwrite yesterday's (2026-09-29) either.

You could edit the score directly in your journal app, if it lets you. Or I could add a new entry with the score of 6, but only on a date that doesn't have an entry yet. That would mean a different date, so it probably isn't what you want.

I can also pull up yesterday's entry so you can see what's there.
cost_note: Estimate at $3/$15 per million input/output tokens. Not an invoice figure.

content.thinking: There's no update tool available, only create_entry, which would fail since the entry already exists. I'm weighing whether to fetch the entry first to show its current state, but I'll explain the limitation and offer the user some options instead.
